对于 Netaanilumina 来说，这是一个非常简单的工作流程。能够切换提示前缀，自动将 @ 附加到艺术家标签，并通常简化流程并使用 A1111 风格的元数据保存图像。

o.en:
Please read the README note in the workflow!

This is a mostly straightforward workflow for Netaanilumina. Has the ability to switch around prompt prefixes, automatically appends @ to artist tags, and generally streamlines the process and saves images with A1111-style metadata.
